job_post_detail.title: Product Designer-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Assist in crafting UI/UX designs for Insta360’s online store and official website, contributing to improved user experience and conversion rates.
2、Support the maintenance and updating of design systems and component libraries, ensuring consistency across projects.
3、Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, operations, and development, to ensure designs meet both brand and business goals.
4、Participate in the design of landing pages for various domestic and international campaigns, working on localization and quality enhancement of design styles.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Strong foundation in UI design, with a basic understanding of UX principles; photography or imagery knowledge is a plus.
2、Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher in UI/UX, design, or related fields, with a portfolio of relevant work.
3、Proficiency in English or Japanese; overseas study experience is preferred.
4、Attach a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link showcasing your design work in your application (e.g., Behance or personal website).
5、This internship is ideal for a proactive, detail-oriented design student eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
